faq.question: このJPGからPNGへの変換ツールは本当に無料ですか？
faq.answer: はい。制限、透かし、隠れた料金は一切ありません。すべての変換はブラウザ内でローカルに実行されます。

faq.question: 画像はサーバーにアップロードされますか？
faq.answer: いいえ。このツールはブラウザのCanvas APIとWeb Workersを使用してローカルで画像を変換します — ファイルがデバイスから外部に送信されることはありません。

faq.question: iPhoneのHEICファイルを変換できますか？
faq.answer: はい、HEICファイルに対応しており、標準のPNG形式に自動的に変換されます。

faq.question: バッチ変換に制限はありますか？
faq.answer: 人為的な制限はありません — 唯一の制約はデバイスの利用可能なメモリです。

faq.question: Will converting JPG to PNG make the file larger?
faq.answer: Usually yes. PNG uses lossless compression, so a photo with lots of detail or gradients often becomes several times larger than the original JPG. If file size matters more than lossless quality, stick with JPG or try WebP instead.

faq.question: Does converting JPG to PNG add transparency?
faq.answer: No. JPG has no alpha channel, so the PNG output is fully opaque with no transparent pixels. To make parts of an image transparent you'd need a background remover tool first.

faq.question: What's the maximum image size this tool can handle?
faq.answer: It depends on your device's available memory, since conversion happens in your browser rather than on a server. Very large images (tens of megapixels) may slow down or fail on low-memory devices, but typical photos convert in a second or two.

faq.question: Can I convert multiple JPG files to PNG at once?
faq.answer: Yes, you can select or drag in several JPG or HEIC files and each one is converted and downloaded as its own PNG.

faq.question: 結合前にページの順序を変更できますか？

faq.question: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faq.answer: No. Encrypted or password-protected PDFs can't currently be opened by the merge tool since decryption isn't supported. Remove the password using the file's original application first, then merge.

faq.question: What happens if one of my PDFs is corrupted?
faq.answer: If a file can't be parsed, the tool will show an error for that specific file rather than silently skipping it. Try opening and re-saving the corrupted file in another PDF viewer before merging.

faq.question: Will merging preserve bookmarks, forms, and links?
faq.answer: Page content, images, and text are preserved, but interactive elements like form fields, bookmarks, and internal links from the source files may not carry over into the merged output.

faq.question: What is the merged file named?
faq.answer: The combined PDF downloads as merged.pdf by default. You can rename it after download like any other file on your device.

faq.question: What's the difference between beautify and minify here?
faq.answer: Beautify adds indentation and line breaks for readability; minify strips all unnecessary whitespace to produce the smallest possible output — both represent the same underlying data.

faq.question: 税金は考慮されますか？
faq.answer: いいえ、これは総支給額のみを計算します。手取り収入の見積もりについては税務専門家に相談してください。

faq.question: 労働時間をカスタマイズできますか？
faq.answer: はい、スケジュールに合わせて週あたりの時間数と年間の有給週数を調整できます。

faq.question: How do you calculate daily and weekly rates?
faq.answer: Daily rate is your hourly rate multiplied by hours worked per day (derived from hours per week ÷ 5); weekly rate is hourly rate times hours per week.

faq.question: What if I work part-time?
faq.answer: Adjust the hours per week field to your actual schedule — the calculator recalculates all rates from that number.

faq.question: Does this account for overtime pay?
faq.answer: No, it assumes a flat rate across all hours entered. For overtime-adjusted pay, calculate regular and overtime hours separately.

faq.question: Why does monthly pay not equal weekly pay times 4?
faq.answer: Monthly pay is annual salary divided by 12, not weekly pay times 4, since most months have slightly more than 4 weeks.

faq.question: 写真はどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: どのiPhoneの写真でも機能しますか？

faq.question: 写真の品質は損なわれますか？

faq.question: What's the difference between HEIC and HEIF?
faq.answer: HEIC is Apple's specific implementation of the HEIF (High Efficiency Image Format) container — the terms are often used interchangeably, and this tool accepts both file extensions.

faq.question: Does the converted JPG include the original photo's orientation?
faq.answer: The conversion process doesn't read or transfer EXIF orientation data, so double-check the output — if your photo appears rotated, you may need to rotate it manually afterward.

faq.question: Can I convert Live Photos from my iPhone?
faq.answer: Only the still HEIC image is converted — the paired video portion of a Live Photo isn't processed or included.

faq.question: Why does my browser show a blank preview for HEIC files before converting?
faq.answer: Most desktop browsers can't natively render HEIC images in an `` tag, so you may see a blank or broken thumbnail until the file is actually converted.

faq.question: 圧縮によって画質は低下しますか？
faq.answer: 非可逆圧縮では多少の画質低下が予想されますが、70〜85%の品質では通常違いは知覚できません。

faq.question: 画像はサーバーにアップロードされますか？
faq.answer: いいえ、すべてCanvas APIを使用してローカルで行われます — ファイルがデバイスから外部に送信されることはありません。

faq.question: What compression method does this tool use?
faq.answer: It re-encodes your image using your browser's built-in canvas image encoder at an adjustable quality level — no external compression library is used.

faq.question: Should I compress a PNG or a JPG for smaller file size?
faq.answer: JPG compression is lossy and generally shrinks photos much more than PNG, which is lossless — for photos, converting to JPG first typically saves more space than compressing a PNG.

faq.question: Does compressing an image multiple times keep degrading it?
faq.answer: Yes, since JPG compression is lossy, re-compressing an already-compressed JPG repeatedly will introduce additional quality loss each time.

faq.question: What's a good quality setting to use?
faq.answer: 70-85% is a common sweet spot that noticeably reduces file size while keeping visible quality loss minimal — lower it further if file size matters more than appearance.

faq.question: What happens if I only set a width or only a height?

faq.question: Can I resize an image to be larger than the original?
faq.answer: Yes, there's no upper limit — you can enter dimensions larger than the source image, though upscaling beyond the original resolution can make the result look soft or pixelated.

faq.question: Does resizing change the file format?

faq.question: Can I resize to a specific file size instead of pixel dimensions?
faq.answer: No, this tool only resizes by pixel dimensions or percentage — for a specific file size target, use the Image Compressor afterward.

faq.question: WebPはすべてのブラウザでサポートされていますか？

faq.question: How much smaller are WebP files compared to JPG or PNG?

faq.question: Can I control the WebP compression quality?

faq.question: Does WebP support transparency like PNG?

faq.answer: A data URL wraps the Base64 string with a `data:image/png;base64,` prefix that tells a browser how to interpret it directly — the raw string alone is just the encoded bytes.

faq.question: Can I decode a Base64 string back into a downloadable image file?
faq.answer: Yes, switch to the decode tab, paste your Base64 string or data URL, and download the resulting image file directly.

faq.question: Why would I embed an image as Base64 instead of linking to a file?
faq.answer: Embedding avoids a separate network request, which is useful for small icons in CSS/HTML or inline email images, though it increases the size of the containing file.

faq.question: Will very large or high-page-count PDFs slow down my browser?
faq.answer: Rendering happens page by page in your browser, so PDFs with hundreds of pages or very large embedded images can take noticeably longer and use more memory than a short document.

faq.question: Will my images be recompressed or lose quality?

faq.question: What happens if I enter an invalid page number?

faq.question: 圧縮は品質やコンテンツに影響しますか？

faq.question: Can I compress a password-protected PDF?

faq.question: Why does compressing a scanned PDF barely reduce its size?
faq.answer: Scanned PDFs are usually made of one large image per page that's already compressed by the scanner, so this tool's lossless optimization of PDF structure and embedded fonts has little left to trim compared with text-based PDFs.

faq.question: Does compression remove any content from my PDF?
faq.answer: No. Compression optimizes the internal PDF structure, such as removing duplicate objects and streamlining fonts, without deleting pages, text, or images.

faq.question: What is the compressed file named?

faq.question: Why do two slightly different inputs produce completely different hashes?

faq.question: Can I use SHA-1 for security purposes?

faq.question: 返済額の計算にはどの式が使用されますか？
faq.answer: 返済額 = [P × r × (1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n − 1]、Pは元本、rは月利、nは月数です。

faq.question: これには手数料や保険が含まれますか？

faq.question: これは住宅ローンや自動車ローンに適していますか？

faq.question: What does EMI stand for?
faq.answer: Equated Monthly Installment — a fixed payment amount made every month that covers both principal and interest over the loan term.

faq.question: Why does more of my early payments go to interest?
faq.answer: Interest is calculated on the remaining balance each month, which is highest at the start of the loan, so early payments are interest-heavy even though the total payment stays fixed.

faq.question: Can I see a full payment-by-payment breakdown?
faq.answer: Yes, expand the amortization schedule below the results to see principal, interest, and remaining balance for every month of the loan.

faq.question: What happens if I enter a 0% interest rate?
faq.answer: The calculator switches to a simple even split of the loan amount across the number of months, with no interest added.

faq.answer: メートル法：体重（kg）/身長（m）²。ヤードポンド法：体重（lb）/身長（in）² × 703です。

faq.question: BMIのカテゴリーは何ですか？
faq.answer: 18.5未満は低体重、18.5〜24.9は標準体重、25〜29.9は肥満（前段階）、30以上は肥満です。

faq.question: BMIは完璧な健康指標ですか？
faq.answer: いいえ、BMIは筋肉量、骨密度、体組成を考慮しません。完全な評価については医療専門家にご相談ください。

faq.question: Does BMI differ for men and women?
faq.answer: The BMI formula itself is the same for everyone — it doesn't adjust for sex, which is part of why it's considered a rough screening tool rather than a precise health measure.

faq.question: What's a healthy BMI range?
faq.answer: 18.5 to 24.9 is generally classified as a healthy weight range for adults, though this can vary by individual factors like muscle mass and body frame.

faq.question: Can I switch between metric and imperial units?

faq.question: Is BMI accurate for athletes?
faq.answer: Not always — BMI doesn't distinguish muscle from fat, so muscular individuals can show a higher BMI despite having low body fat.

howTo.name: 年齢を確認
howTo.text: 年・月・日単位の正確な年齢を確認します。

faq.question: 年齢はどのように計算されますか？
faq.answer: 2つの日付間の完全な暦年・暦月・日数をカウントします — 単純な日数の割り算ではありません。

faq.question: 未来や過去の日付での年齢も計算できますか？
faq.answer: はい、「基準日」を変更すれば、任意の日付における年齢を確認できます。

faq.question: 生年月日はどこかに保存されますか？
faq.answer: いいえ、すべての計算はブラウザ内でローカルに行われ、サーバーには何も送信されません。

faq.question: Does this account for leap years?
faq.answer: Yes, the calculation uses actual calendar dates, so leap years are automatically factored into total days and the days-until-next-birthday count.

faq.question: Can I calculate someone else's age, not just my own?
faq.answer: Yes, enter any birth date — the tool isn't limited to your own date of birth.

faq.question: What does 'total months' include?
faq.answer: It's your full age converted into a single number of months, combining the years and months shown above it.

faq.question: Why would I calculate age as of a past date?
faq.answer: Useful for figuring out how old someone was at a specific historical event or document date, not just their current age.

faq.question: コードやJSONも比較できますか？

faq.question: テキストはどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: Can I switch between line-level and word-level diffing?

faq.question: Does it ignore whitespace differences?

faq.question: Can I see the diff as a unified patch?

faq.question: Does it handle very large text blocks?

faq.question: このパスワード生成ツールは安全ですか？
faq.answer: はい。パスワードはブラウザの暗号学的に安全な乱数生成器（crypto.getRandomValues）を使用して生成され、より弱い擬似乱数関数は使用しません。

faq.question: 生成されたパスワードはどこかに送信されますか？
faq.answer: いいえ。すべてブラウザ内でローカルに処理されます — パスワードがサーバーに送信・保存されることは一切ありません。

faq.question: 強いパスワードとは何ですか？
faq.answer: 長さが最も重要です。大文字・小文字・数字・記号を組み合わせた長いパスワードは、短くシンプルなものよりはるかに解読が困難です。

faq.question: Can I exclude ambiguous characters like 0, O, l, and 1?
faq.answer: No, there's no option to exclude visually similar characters — all characters from your selected categories (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols) are equally eligible.

faq.question: What's the maximum password length I can generate?
faq.answer: You can generate passwords well beyond typical requirements, though most sites cap accepted lengths, so check the target system's limit before using a very long one.

faq.question: Does it guarantee at least one character from each selected category?
faq.answer: No, characters are picked uniformly at random from the combined set of selected categories, so it's statistically likely but not guaranteed that every category appears in a given password.

faq.question: Is it better to use a long passphrase or a random password?
faq.answer: Both can be strong — a long random password packs more entropy per character, while a passphrase of several random words is easier to type and remember; this tool is built for the random-character approach.

faq.question: PDFはどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: Can I skip numbering on the first page, like a cover page?
faq.answer: No, every page gets a number — there's no option to exclude a specific page like a cover page from numbering. You can set the starting number, but that changes what number the first page displays, not whether it's numbered.

faq.question: Can I add page numbers to an encrypted PDF?
faq.answer: No, password-protected PDFs can't currently be opened by the tool. Remove the password in the original application before adding page numbers.

faq.question: Will page numbers overlap existing content near the page edges?
faq.answer: Page numbers are placed in the margin area you select (such as bottom center or bottom right), but if your document already has content very close to that margin, the added number can visually overlap it.

faq.question: Can I customize the font size or color of the page numbers?
faq.answer: The tool currently applies a standard font size and color for page numbers; there's no option to customize typography, only position, starting number, and number format.

faq.question: 文字数の制限はありますか？
faq.answer: 実質的な制限はありません — 長いテキストでもブラウザ内で瞬時に変換されます。

faq.question: How does it decide word boundaries when converting from camelCase or snake_case?
faq.answer: It splits on case transitions, underscores, hyphens, and spaces to detect word boundaries before reassembling into the target case format.

faq.question: Does it preserve acronyms when converting case?
faq.answer: Acronyms are treated like any other run of letters and will be reformatted to match the target case (e.g. lowercase in kebab-case), not preserved as-is.

faq.question: Can I convert multiple lines at once?
faq.answer: Yes, the whole text block you paste in is converted as one unit, so multiple lines convert together.

faq.question: What case types are supported?
faq.answer: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and kebab-case are all available.

faq.question: どのメタデータが削除されますか？
faq.answer: カメラのメーカー・機種、レンズ情報、撮影日時、ISO、GPS座標など、EXIF情報全体が画像の再エンコード時に削除されます。

faq.question: 写真はどこかにアップロードされますか？
faq.answer: いいえ。メタデータの読み取りと画像の再エンコードはすべてブラウザ内で行われ、サーバーには一切送信されません。

faq.question: メタデータを削除すると画質は落ちますか？
faq.answer: 画像は高品質（95%）で再エンコードされるため、ほとんどの用途で差はほぼ感じられません。

faq.question: Can I selectively remove just GPS data and keep other metadata?
faq.answer: No, stripping is all-or-nothing — the tool removes all metadata (GPS, camera, lens, date, ISO) at once by re-encoding the image, rather than letting you choose individual fields to keep.

faq.question: Which metadata fields are commonly found in phone photos?
faq.answer: Common fields include camera make and model, capture date and time, GPS coordinates, orientation, and sometimes the software used to edit the photo. Not every photo contains all of these.

faq.question: Does removing EXIF data affect how the photo displays or its orientation?
faq.answer: The tool preserves visible orientation by applying rotation to the actual pixels rather than relying on the orientation tag, so the photo displays correctly even after the tag is removed.

faq.question: Do I need to view the metadata before stripping it?
faq.answer: No, viewing the extracted fields is optional — you can strip metadata immediately without reviewing what's there first.

faq.question: テキストはどこかに送信されますか？

faq.question: Does it detect characters I can't normally see in a text editor?
faq.answer: Yes, it scans for zero-width spaces, joiners, and other invisible Unicode characters that render as nothing in most editors.

faq.question: Can it show me a count of how many invisible characters were found?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool reports exactly how many invisible characters were found and removed from your text.

faq.question: Will this remove legitimate formatting characters like non-breaking spaces?
faq.answer: Only zero-width and other genuinely invisible characters are targeted — verify the specific character set covered if you rely on non-breaking spaces for layout, since removal behavior depends on which characters are flagged.

faq.question: Why would invisible characters break my code or CMS content?
faq.answer: Zero-width characters can silently break string comparisons, search functionality, and copy-pasted code — since they're invisible, they're difficult to spot without a tool like this.

faq.answer: ブラウザ標準のWeb Crypto API（crypto.subtle）を使用し、選択したハッシュアルゴリズムで鍵とメッセージを安全に署名します。

faq.question: 秘密鍵はどこかに送信されますか？
faq.answer: いいえ、すべての計算はブラウザ内でローカルに行われ、鍵やメッセージが送信されることはありません。

faq.question: HMACと通常のハッシュの違いは何ですか？
faq.answer: 通常のハッシュには秘密鍵がなく誰でも計算できますが、HMACは秘密鍵とメッセージを組み合わせるため、完全性と真正性の両方を検証できます。

faq.question: Which hash algorithms can I use for the HMAC?
faq.answer: HMAC can be computed with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512 as the underlying hash function, matching what's available in the Web Crypto API.

faq.question: Can the secret key be any text, or does it need to be hex?
faq.answer: The secret is always treated as plain text and UTF-8 encoded before use — there's no hex or Base64 key-encoding mode, so enter the key exactly as plain text.

faq.question: Why would I use HMAC instead of just hashing the message?
faq.answer: A plain hash proves the message wasn't altered but anyone can compute it; HMAC also requires knowledge of a shared secret key, so it proves the message came from someone who holds that key.

faq.question: Can this verify an HMAC signature I received, like a webhook signature?
faq.answer: Yes, you can recompute the HMAC from the message and secret and compare it to the received signature manually, though the tool doesn't automate the comparison for you.

faq.question: JSONはどこかにアップロードされますか？
faq.answer: いいえ、型の生成はすべてブラウザ内で完結します。

faq.question: How does it handle arrays with mixed element types?
faq.answer: It infers a type from the array's elements — for mixed types, expect a union type or a broader type that covers the variety present, since JSON itself doesn't declare a single element type.

faq.question: Are optional and nullable fields detected?
faq.answer: Optional/nullable handling depends on your sample JSON — a field that's `null` in your input is typed accordingly, but the generator can only infer from the one JSON sample you provide, not from multiple variations.

faq.question: Can I generate a type alias instead of an interface?
faq.answer: Yes, a toggle lets you switch between generating a TypeScript `interface` or a `type` alias.

faq.question: Does the Zod schema output include validation like min/max?
faq.answer: No, the generated Zod schema only reflects the basic type shape (string, number, optional, etc.) — it doesn't add constraints like min/max length or numeric ranges.

faq.question: データはどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: 複雑なネスト構造も変換できますか？
faq.answer: はい、両方向とも深くネストされたオブジェクトやオブジェクトの配列に対応しています。

faq.question: How does it represent JSON null values in YAML?
faq.answer: JSON null values are written as the literal `null` in the YAML output, matching standard YAML convention.

faq.question: Are YAML anchors and aliases supported when converting back to JSON?
faq.answer: No, anchors (&) and aliases (*) aren't recognized by the parser — pasted YAML using them won't convert correctly.

faq.question: Does indentation matter when pasting YAML in?
faq.answer: Yes, the parser reads structure from indentation levels, so inconsistent or incorrect indentation in pasted YAML can produce an incorrect or failed conversion.

faq.question: Can it round-trip YAML comments?
faq.answer: No, comments (lines or trailing text starting with #) are stripped when parsing YAML back to JSON — JSON itself has no comment syntax to preserve them in.

faq.question: 圧縮でどのくらいサイズが削減されますか？
faq.answer: 元のコードにどれだけ空白やコメントが含まれているかによって異なります。ツール上で削減前後のサイズを正確に比較できます。

faq.question: コードはどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: Are HTML comments always removed?

faq.question: Does minifying CSS remove unused rules?

faq.question: Can I reverse minification to get readable code back?

faq.answer: By default it targets characters with reserved meaning in HTML, like <, >, &, and quotes; there's a separate option to encode all non-ASCII characters as numeric entities if you need that.

faq.question: What's the difference between named and numeric entities?
faq.answer: Named entities like & are more readable, while numeric entities like & work for any Unicode code point, including ones without a defined name — this tool can output either.

faq.question: Why do I need to encode characters like & in HTML attributes?
faq.answer: Unencoded & or quote characters inside attribute values can break the HTML parser or be misread as marking the start of an entity, so encoding keeps the attribute value intact.

faq.question: Can decoding handle entities without a trailing semicolon?
faq.answer: Most browsers tolerate some named entities without a semicolon, but this decoder expects well-formed entities ending in a semicolon for reliable results.

faq.question: 最初と最後の単語は常に大文字になりますか？

faq.answer: It uses style-specific rules (AP, APA, Chicago, or MLA) that define which short articles, conjunctions, and prepositions stay lowercase unless they start or end the title.

faq.question: Does it handle hyphenated words correctly?
faq.answer: Hyphenated words are capitalized as a single token rather than capitalizing each part after the hyphen separately — so "well-known" becomes "Well-known", not "Well-Known".

faq.question: Can it capitalize titles with subtitles separated by a colon?
faq.answer: Yes, text is processed as a continuous string, so both the title and subtitle portions get title-cased consistently.

faq.question: Does it preserve intentional stylized capitalization, like brand names?
faq.answer: No, every word is reformatted according to the selected style's rules, so stylized capitalization (like "eBay" or "iPhone") will be normalized rather than preserved.

faq.question: SVGはどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: Will optimizing break animations or JavaScript that references my SVG's IDs?

faq.question: Can I paste raw SVG markup instead of uploading a file?

faq.question: What video format does the recording download as?

faq.question: Can I record just one browser tab instead of my whole screen?
faq.answer: Yes, but the choice between full screen, a window, or a specific tab comes from your browser's own native screen-sharing picker, not a setting inside this tool.

faq.question: Why does my browser ask for permission every time I record?

faq.question: Does system audio get captured along with my microphone?

faq.question: AAとAAAの違いは何ですか？
faq.answer: AAは標準的なアクセシビリティ基準（通常テキストで4.5:1、大きいテキストで3:1）、AAAはより厳格な強化基準（それぞれ7:1、4.5:1）です。

faq.question: 「大きいテキスト」とは何を指しますか？
faq.answer: 18pt以上、または14pt以上の太字のテキストは、より緩やかな大きいテキストの基準が適用されます。

faq.question: Does this tool check contrast for UI elements, not just text?
faq.answer: No, it checks the four standard text-contrast thresholds (AA and AAA, normal and large text) only — it doesn't check the separate 3:1 ratio WCAG requires for non-text UI components and graphical objects.

faq.question: Can I enter colors as HEX, RGB, or color names?
faq.answer: Most versions accept HEX codes and RGB values directly; check the input field for which formats are supported before typing in a color name.

faq.question: Why did my colors pass AA but fail AAA?
faq.answer: AAA requires a stricter 7:1 ratio for normal text compared to AA's 4.5:1, so a color pair with moderate contrast can satisfy the more lenient AA standard while falling short of AAA.

faq.question: What's the difference between AA and AAA compliance?
faq.answer: AA is the standard minimum most sites aim for (4.5:1 for normal text); AAA is a stricter, optional level (7:1) recommended for content aimed at users with low vision.

faq.answer: 幅と高さを最大公約数（GCD）で割ることで、1920×1080が16:9になるような最もシンプルな整数比を求めます。

faq.question: 幅ではなく高さを基準に拡大縮小できますか？
faq.answer: はい、目標の高さを入力すると対応する幅が計算され、その逆も可能です。比率を固定するため、一度に編集できるのはどちらか一方のみです。

faq.question: データはどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: What does the simplified ratio (e.g. 16:9) mean?
faq.answer: It's your width and height reduced to the smallest whole numbers that keep the same proportion, using their greatest common divisor.

faq.question: Can I lock the ratio and enter a target width to find the height?
faq.answer: Yes, entering either dimension automatically scales the other to preserve the original aspect ratio.

faq.question: Is this useful for video and screen resolutions too?
faq.answer: Yes, it works for any width/height pair — video frames, monitor resolutions, print dimensions, and image crops all use the same ratio math.

faq.question: What's the difference between aspect ratio and resolution?
faq.answer: Resolution is the exact pixel dimensions (e.g. 1920×1080); aspect ratio is the proportional relationship between width and height (e.g. 16:9), which many different resolutions can share.

faq.question: Can I resize or move the webcam overlay after starting the recording?
faq.answer: No, the webcam overlay appears as a fixed-size circle in the bottom-right corner — its position and size aren't adjustable, only whether it's shown or hidden.

faq.question: What happens if I don't have a webcam connected?
faq.answer: The tool will prompt for webcam access, and if none is available or permission is denied, you can typically still record your screen without the picture-in-picture overlay.

faq.question: What format is the final recording saved in?
faq.answer: Like other browser-based recording tools here, output is typically saved as a WebM video file, combining your screen, webcam, and microphone into a single track.

faq.question: Can I record with the webcam overlay but without a screen share?
faq.answer: This tool is built around combining screen and webcam together, so if you only want a webcam recording, the standalone audio or a simple webcam-only capture would be a better fit.

faq.question: なぜ最大録画時間が設定されているのですか？
faq.answer: アニメーションGIFは動画コーデックと比べて各フレームをほぼ無圧縮で保持するため、ファイルサイズとエンコード時間が急速に増大します。時間を制限することで書き出しを高速かつ扱いやすく保っています。

faq.question: フレームレートを下げるとなぜファイルが小さくなるのですか？
faq.answer: フレーム数が少ないほどエンコード・保存するデータ量が減りますが、動きの滑らかさは犠牲になります。多くの画面録画では8〜10fpsが良いバランスです。

faq.question: これはどこかにアップロードされますか？

faq.question: Can I trim the recording before exporting as GIF?
faq.answer: No, the entire recording from start to stop is encoded as the GIF — there's no post-recording trim step, so stop recording when you've captured what you need.

faq.question: Can I loop the GIF or does it play once?
faq.answer: Animated GIFs loop by default in virtually all browsers and apps that display them, so your exported file will replay automatically without any extra setting needed.

faq.question: Why does my GIF look like it has fewer colors than my screen?
faq.answer: The GIF format is limited to a palette of 256 colors per frame, so smooth gradients or photo-like content can show visible banding compared to the original screen recording.

faq.question: Does the recording include my microphone audio?
faq.answer: No, GIF is an image-only format with no audio track, so any microphone or system audio isn't captured or included in the output.

faq.question: Does the live level meter affect recording quality?

faq.question: Can I trim silence from the beginning or end of my recording?
faq.answer: This tool is focused on capture rather than editing, so trimming isn't typically included. You'd want to use a dedicated audio or video trimmer afterward if you need to cut dead air.

faq.question: What audio format is the recording saved as?
faq.answer: Recordings use WebM with Opus audio when your browser supports it, falling back to MP4/M4A otherwise — the exact format depends on your browser's capabilities.

faq.question: What annotation shapes and tools are available besides arrows and text?
